note_cn: AI 牛市的四只领头羊:NVDA(算力)、MSFT(应用+底座)、META(广告/Llama)、GOOGL(广告+TPU)。图上 TTM PE 由日股价 ÷ 步进式 TTM 摊薄 EPS 算出;动态 PE 是当前一致预期快照,在下方卡片显示。横向虚线参考带是 1999-2000 网络泡沫五巨头的动态 PE 峰值:CSCO 140×、ORCL 150×、SUNW 120×、MSFT(1999)60×、INTC(2000)50×。今天 NVDA 与 1999 的 Cisco 落差,是这张图的核心问题。
note_en: The four leaders of the AI bull: NVDA (compute), MSFT (apps + foundation), META (ads + Llama), GOOGL (ads + TPUs). TTM PE = daily price ÷ step-function TTM diluted EPS; current forward PE is shown as a snapshot in the cards below. The dashed reference bands mark the 1999-2000 dotcom-peak forward PE prints of the five leaders that ran ahead of that bubble: CSCO 140×, ORCL 150×, SUNW 120×, MSFT (1999) 60×, INTC (2000) 50×. The core question this chart asks: how far is today's NVDA from the Cisco of 1999?
